caption: The drawing depicts a section of an interior wall featuring a wooden door and a built-in wooden cabinet or panel, both with a natural medium-brown wood finish. The door is located on the left side of the composition, and it has vertical wood grain and rectangular recessed panels. Adjacent to the door, towards the right, is a tall, narrow cabinet or panel with a similar wood finish and matching design, including a smaller recessed panel below. Both the door and the cabinet or panel have dark metal hinges and hardware. Below the cabinet or panel, there are three small knobs or hooks attached to the wood trim. The wall behind the woodwork is painted a light beige or off-white color. At the bottom right of the drawing, there is a black metal vent cover embedded in the baseboard, which matches the wood finish of the rest of the trim. The floor is depicted with a brown tone suggesting wood flooring. The drawing is framed by a wide, plain off-white border.
title: Shaker Built-In Cupboard
